headline: ams OSRAM authors report shared functional coverage across DMS and AMS verification of analog IP
fact: A DVCon Europe 2025 paper by ams OSRAM authors describes collecting analog-IP functional coverage from the same UVM top-level testbench for real-number models and transistor-level schematics. A common real-valued reference and mixed-signal sampler supported both modes; the authors report that AMS runs exposed effects such as glitch filtering that the real-number model did not reproduce.

sources.title: Implementing Functional Coverage for Analog IPs in Mixed-Signal Verification Environments
sources.summary: DVCon's record identifies the ams OSRAM functional-coverage paper.

sources.title: Implementing Functional Coverage for Analog IPs in Mixed-Signal Verification Environments — paper
sources.summary: The paper documents the shared UVM coverage approach across DMS and AMS modes and the analog effects observed only in schematic runs.
